name: Record Player
summary: Turntable with platter, record and tone arm; the record spins on request. Use for vinyl, music or retro scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the plinth rests on y; set y to a table top to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 640 px wide at s = 1; about 0.4 on a table next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = the record turns on the platter and the arm sways

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (tone arm moves to the left)

author: krakujs
